title: AADP Evidence Module v1.0 — Evidence reference
description: Component schema (not a top-level module document kind). One edge from a claim to an evidence document (specification.md §7). `target` is the released Relations `1.0` target component, unmodified — Evidence does not copy or fork that schema, and the Relations `x_*` extension point on it is preserved. `target_type` is the CONSTANT `evidence`, not a free token: that constant is what makes the `1.0` model acyclic by construction (§7.1), since a claim can then point neither at another claim nor at itself. `confidence`'s decimal precision is a semantic rule, not a schema one — `multipleOf` cannot express "at most 2 decimal places" without binary floating-point false negatives.
